body:
Hi Dustin,

When someone in Lake Havasu hears you are the electrician to call, the first thing they do is Google you. What they find is a stack of directory listings, BuildZoom, Birdeye, the BBB, but no website of your own. There is nowhere they can check your services, see that you are licensed under ROC 334959, or reach you without digging through somebody else's page. Your 13 Google reviews are all five stars, and right now they are doing that selling on sites you do not control.

So I built you a homepage, and the finished design is attached to this email as a PDF. It leads with your number, (928) 889-1769, lays out your services from ceiling fans and outlets to 220v lines and spa hookups, and shows off your reviews and your family owned story.

Two similar sites from my portfolio: I built the website for DP Electric (dpelectric.com), an Arizona electrical contractor, with clear services and fast contact options. I also built K2 Electric's site (k2elec.com), another Arizona electrician, set up so customers can find the right service and call in one tap.

If you like it, I can put it on a domain of your own and build out the rest of the pages. If not, keep the PDF as free ideas, no hard feelings.

Best,
Hassan
name: Killen It Electric LLC
subject: ⚡ Dustin, 13 five-star reviews and no website to send people to
